settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.subtitle: Customise your appearance, language and account.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Pick a look. "System" follows your device's light or dark mode.

study.title: Study
study.description: Customise the study modes on this device.
study.soundHint: Play a chime when you answer correctly or swipe a card as “Know it”.
study.reminderHint: Get a notification around 8 PM if you haven't studied that day. Applies to this device/browser.
study.reminderUnsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.
study.reminderIosHint: On iPhone/iPad (iOS 16.4+), tap Share → Add to Home Screen, then open the app from that icon to enable reminders.
study.reminderDenied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them again in your browser settings.
study.reminderUnavailable: Study reminders aren't configured on the server yet.
study.reminderNeedsInstall: Reminders need the production app served over HTTPS.
study.reminderEnabled: Study reminder enabled on this device.
study.reminderDisabled: Study reminder turned off on this device.
study.reminderFailed: Couldn't enable the reminder. Please try again.
study.restoresHint: If you miss 1–3 days, you can spend 1 restore per missed day when you come back to keep your streak. Earn 1 for every {reviews} reviews (up to {max}); topped up to 3 each month if lower.
study.restoresProgress: {count} more reviews until your next restore.

language.title: Language
language.description: The app's language. Your own study cards are never translated.

verify.description: Open the link in the confirmation email to verify this address. Until then you cannot make sets public and can generate with AI {limit} times a day and study up to {studyLimit} reviews. Can't find it? Check your spam folder or resend it below (links are valid for 24 hours).
verify.sentHint: A new link was sent to {email}. Older links no longer work.
verify.failed: Could not send the email. Please try again.

password.title: Change password
password.description: Changing it signs you out on every device, so you'll sign in again.
password.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one.
password.success: Password changed. Please sign in again.
password.failed: Couldn't change your password. Please try again.
password.oauthOnly: This account signs in with Google, so it has no password yet. To sign in with a password, set one via
